description.narrative: (Zimbabwe): .The integrated maternal, newborn, and child health (MNCH) and family planning (FP) activity will target Manicaland province with intensive MNCH support and provide comprehensive FP services nationwide. .. ..The objectives of this activity are to:.Improve the quality of MNCH-FP services;Increase the use of MNCH-FP services among hard to reach populations;Strengthen community systems and linkages to integrated MNCH-FP services; andImprove national capacity for policy implementation..Using FY 2021 funds, the activity will:.Strengthen health worker knowledge and skills to deliver high-impact MNCH and FP interventions through training, mentorship, and supervision focused on prevention and management of obstetric and neonatal complications and disabilities; Support village health workers to expand MNCH and FP service delivery; Deliver FP services in remote areas via outreach and mobile clinics; Improve linkages between health facilities and communities, and strengthen prevention and management of obstetric and newborn complications and disabilities; Improve health center committee functionality; Increase service uptake via community dialogues; Support immunizations and the introduction of new vaccines; and Support Ministry of Health and Child Care (MOHCC) national policy formulation and implementation. Mitigate the impact of the COVID pandemic on access to and delivery of quality MNCH and FP. Support family-centered, respectful maternity care in service delivery platforms through improved caregiver communication, promoting choice of birth positions, encouraging family member support during labor and partner involvement throughout care. .This activity will improve demand for and the availability of quality MNCH-FP services in the seven districts of Manicaland Province; increase access to FP nationwide; and improve MOHCC's and the Zimbabwe National Family Planning Council's capacity for policy formulation and implementation..
